plan.objective: Explore the glowing mushroom cavern to mine >= 45 metal ore (Lead/Iron/Silver/Tungsten/Gold), loot Chests, and consume Life Crystals until max HP >= 140.

tasks.task: Explore open underground caverns placing Torches (slot 7) for visibility, mine exposed Lead/Silver/Gold Ore veins until >= 45 metal ore total, loot all Chests encountered, and mine and use Life Crystals to raise max HP to >= 140.
tasks.done_when: Inventory holds >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or Tungsten/Platinum equivalents and Chest weapon/accessory upgrades) and max HP is >= 140.

tasks.task: Return to the surface house (or use a safe dry ledge with Work Bench), craft a Furnace (20 Stone, 4 Wood, 3 Torches) and Anvil (5 Iron/Lead Bars), smelt metal ore into bars, and craft an upgraded metal Bow, metal Armor pieces, and >= 150 Flaming/Jester's Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Equipped metal armor upgrades and upgraded bow (or strong Chest ranged weapon) with >= 150 arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Gather Wood if needed, build 2 horizontal rows of Wood Platforms (~40 tiles wide, 5-6 tiles apart) near the surface house with a placed Campfire, stock Lesser Healing Potions, and obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye from a cavern Chest or by crafting 6 Lenses at a Demon/Crimson Altar.
tasks.done_when: 2-tier platform arena with Campfire is placed near spawn and Suspicious Looking Eye is in inventory.

tasks.task: Wait for early Night (7:30 PM) on the surface platform arena, use the Suspicious Looking Eye, strafe and jump across platforms to dodge charges while firing arrows continuously, and press H to quick-heal when hurt.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Clear the nearby Mother Slime, move onto dry glowing mushroom ledges, mine >= 45 metal ore (including Tungsten/Lead/Gold), loot Chests, and use Life Crystals to reach >= 140 HP.
Craft a Furnace and Anvil, smelt metal bars, and craft upgraded armor, a metal bow, and >= 150 arrows.
Build a 2-tier Wood Platform arena with a Campfire on the surface and secure a Suspicious Looking Eye and healing potions.
Summon the Eye of Cthulhu at the start of Night on the arena and kite across platforms with ranged attacks until it is defeated.
avoid: Clicking Torches (slot 7) underwater or in open air cells that have no adjacent solid tile or background wall (`NO EFFECT`).
Lingering in deep water pools where drowning, Piranhas, and Blue Jellyfish drain HP instead of jumping onto the dry glowing mushroom ledges to the left.
Holding Pickaxe or Torches while Mother Slime (and the Baby Slimes it spawns on death) is in melee range instead of fighting with Bow or Sword.
Summoning the Eye of Cthulhu during Daytime or before reaching >= 140 HP and setting up a platform arena.
plan.done_when: Max HP is >= 140 and inventory holds >= 45 metal ore (or smelted bars and Chest upgrades) ready for boss gear crafting.

tasks.done_when: Player has descended the vertical shaft and is in the underground Glowing Mushroom cavern below the surface.

tasks.task: Explore open underground caverns placing Torches (slot 7) for visibility, mine exposed Lead/Silver/Gold Ore veins until >= 45 metal ore total, loot all Chests encountered, and mine and use Life Crystals to raise max HP to >= 140.
tasks.done_when: Inventory holds >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or Tungsten/Platinum equivalents and Chest weapon/accessory upgrades) and max HP is >= 140.

tasks.task: Return to the surface house Work Bench, craft and place a Furnace (20 Stone, 4 Wood, 3 Torch) and Iron/Lead Anvil, smelt all collected ore into bars, and craft metal armor, an upgraded bow, and >= 200 Flaming/Jester's Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Metal armor pieces and upgraded ranged weapon are equipped with >= 200 arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Build a 2-row Wood Platform arena (~40 tiles wide, 6 tiles apart) on the surface with a placed Campfire, and collect 6 Lenses at night (or Chest loot) to craft a Suspicious Looking Eye at a Demon/Crimson Altar.
tasks.done_when: 2-tier platform arena with Campfire is placed on the surface and Suspicious Looking Eye is in inventory.

tasks.task: At early Night (7:30 PM) at full HP on the platform arena, use the Suspicious Looking Eye and kite horizontally across platforms while firing arrows continuously and quick-healing as needed until the Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.

steps: Jump over the wooden house roof to the right side, walk left through the right-side door, and drop down the existing vertical shaft into the cavern.
Climb onto dry ledges in the Glowing Mushroom cavern, clear enemies with the Wooden Bow, mine >= 45 metal ore, loot Chests, and consume Life Crystals to reach >= 140 max HP.
Return to the house, craft a Furnace and Anvil, smelt bars, and craft metal armor, an upgraded bow, and 200+ arrows.
Build a 2-tier surface Wood Platform arena with a Campfire and obtain a Suspicious Looking Eye.
Summon and defeat the Eye of Cthulhu at night on the platform arena.
avoid: Starting dig_down on the surface grass instead of using the existing vertical shaft inside the house
Walking repeatedly into the solid left wall of the house (there is no left door; jump onto the roof to reach the right-side door)

Staying submerged in underground water pools while fighting Mother Slimes, Piranhas, or Jellyfish
plan.done_when: Max HP is >= 140 and inventory contains >= 45 Lead/Iron/Silver/Tungsten/Gold Ore (or crafted metal bars/upgrades and Chest loot).

frames.supervisor_strategy: The player is inside the valid surface house at ~80/100 HP with Wood Helmet, Wood Breastplate, Shackle, and Wooden Bow, standing directly above the 2-tile vertical shaft, while zombies wait outside at night. tasks.task: Run dig_down with Copper Pickaxe (slot 2) to mine the 2 solid Wood floor tiles directly beneath your feet sealing the vertical shaft, then fall straight down the shaft into the underground cavern.

tasks.task: Explore open underground caverns placing Torches (slot 7) for visibility, mine exposed Lead/Silver/Gold Ore veins until >= 45 metal ore total, loot all Chests encountered, and mine and use Life Crystals to raise max HP to >= 140.
tasks.done_when: Inventory holds >= 45 Lead/Silver/Gold Ore (or Tungsten/Platinum equivalents and Chest weapon/accessory upgrades) and max HP is >= 140.

tasks.task: At a Work Bench, craft a Furnace (20 Stone, 4 Wood, 3 Torches), smelt all mined ore into bars, craft an Iron/Lead Anvil, and craft metal armor, an upgraded bow, and >= 200 Flaming/Jester's Arrows.
tasks.done_when: Metal armor and upgraded ranged weapon equipped with >= 200 arrows in inventory.

tasks.task: Return to the surface, bridge the shaft floor gap with 2 Wood Platforms, build 2 horizontal rows of ~40 Wood Platforms with a Campfire near the house, and acquire a Suspicious Looking Eye (looted from a Chest or crafted from 6 Lenses at an Altar).
tasks.done_when: 2-tier platform arena with Campfire is placed and Suspicious Looking Eye plus healing potions are in inventory.

tasks.task: Wait for Night (7:30 PM), use the Suspicious Looking Eye on the platform arena, and kite horizontally across platforms firing arrows and quick-healing with H until the Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.
tasks.done_when: Eye of Cthulhu is defeated.
